headline: Ukraine agrees to avoid targeting some tankers and Black Sea oil infrastructure
summary: Investing.com -- Ukraine has agreed not to target certain non-Russian oil tankers or infrastructure used to export Kazakhstan’s crude through the Black Sea, Bloomberg reported, citing a U.S. official familiar with the private agreement.
